description: A forge token: the runner's ask for a served repository's token, the body of its one request to the control plane's runner/forge-token, and the control plane's answer, forge_token_given or forge_token_refused. None goes on a partition's socket.

forge_token.description: The runner asks for a short-lived token of the forge for one repository a drive of the host serves, under the key of a partition served it.

repository.description: The repository the token is asked for.

forge_token_given.description: The control plane minted a token for the repository from the App's installation on the host's account: the ask, by its message's id, the repository, the token and when it expires.

forge_token.description: The ask this answers, by its message's id.

repository.description: The repository the token is for, as the ask named it.

token.description: The token as the forge gave it, which git's credential helper gives as its password: the one field of any version that holds a credential, never written to a file or a log.

expires_at.description: When the token ends, as the forge gave it.

forge_token_refused.description: The control plane gave no token: the ask, by its message's id, the repository, whether the App's installation does not cover it, and words saying why, such as a repository registered to no drive the host serves.

forge_token.description: The ask this answers, by its message's id.

not_installed.description: True alone where the App's installation on the host's account does not cover the repository.
